description: This file contains functions for converting object identifiers and objects between different hash algorithms within a Git repository. It includes functions for converting commit, tree, and tag objects, handling their specific parsing and transformation logic, and coordinating the conversion process.

methods.name: int repo_oid_to_algop(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * src,const struct git_hash_algo * to,struct object_id * dest)
methods.description: Converts an object id from the repository's source algorithm to another specified algorithm, reloading the object map if necessary.

methods.name: int decode_tree_entry_raw(struct object_id * oid,const char ** path,size_t * len,const struct git_hash_algo * algo,const char * buf,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Decodes a raw tree entry from a buffer, extracting the object id and path.

methods.name: int convert_tree_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a tree object buffer from one hash algorithm to another, decoding entries and mapping their object ids.

methods.name: int convert_tag_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a tag object, including signatures and payload, from one hash algorithm to another.

methods.name: int convert_commit_object(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * out,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const char * buffer,size_t size)
methods.description: Converts a commit object, rewriting its fields and signatures for the new hash algorithm.

methods.name: int convert_object_file(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * outbuf,const struct git_hash_algo * from,const struct git_hash_algo * to,const void * buf,size_t len,enum object_type type,int gentle)
methods.description: Main function that dispatches conversion of an object file based on object type, handling failures and mandatory conversion requirements.
